idea-plugin.name: ModuleLoom
idea-plugin.description:
ModuleLoom - Python Architecture & Automated Documentation Engine

ModuleLoom brings real-time Python module dependency graph visualization, architectural diagnostics, and an automated manual documentation engine with local AI integration directly into your PyCharm environment.

🌟 Key Features

  • 🔍 Real-time Dependency & Cycle Detection: Visualize complex package structures, trace circular import paths, and navigate directly to source files with one click.
  • 📖 3-Asset Automated Documentation Engine (Core Highlight): 1-click sync for in-draft Screenshots (with automatic red-circle, bounding box, arrow, and label annotations), Mermaid architecture diagrams from AST, and Docstring API references into MkDocs static sites.
  • 🚨 Code Quality & Architecture Diagnostics: Multi-angle inspection of bloat, duplicate code (bundled jscpd v5), cyclomatic complexity (Lizard/AST), and missing type annotations. Automatically installs diagnostics skills to detected coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor).
  • 🤖 Local AI Integration: Connects to Codex, Claude Code, Grok, or Agy CLI using your local authentication without requiring extra API keys.
  • ⚙️ Centralized Settings: Easy configuration popup for HTML output destination, Markdown source directory, and AI CLI/model selection.
  • 🌐 Dual Language: Full support for English and Japanese (switchable in View → Language).

🇯🇵 日本語での特徴

  • 🔍 依存関係 & 循環インポートのリアルタイム可視化: 複雑なモジュール関係や循環インポート経路を可視化し、エディタと連携して即座に修正可能。
  • 📖 3大アセット自動同期ドキュメント生成エンジン（目玉機能）: 原稿内のスクリーンショット（赤丸・角丸赤枠・矢印・説明文吹き出し自動合成）、Mermaid依存図、DocstringからのAPIリファレンスをボタン1発で自動同期し、MkDocsサイトをビルド。
  • 🚨 コード品質 & アーキテクチャ診断: 肥大化、重複コード（jscpd同梱）、循環、型チェックを多角的に診断し、コーディングエージェントへ診断スキルを自動導入。
  • 🤖 ローカル認証済み AI CLI 連携: Codex、Claude Code、Grok、Agy とAPIキー不要で連携。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.1.0

  • 3-Asset Automated Documentation Engine: Automatic batch screenshot capture with smart annotations (red circles, bounding boxes, arrows, and speech-bubble text labels), Mermaid dependency diagram extraction, and Docstring API reference generation.
  • Centralized Settings Popup: Easy configuration for HTML export target, Markdown source directory, and AI CLI/model settings.
  • Unified Feature Parity: 100% feature parity across Desktop app, PyCharm plugin, and VS Code extension.
  • Smart Annotations: Natural language prompt support for circling elements, arrows, and descriptive labels on screenshot capture.
